uncertain: start pieces: grey kiosk pictogram sits on hex col0 row3; green 3-hex piece (with '3') covers col0 row4, col0 row5, col1 row5 (read from the piece's lobes). Caption says to put them on 'the marked hexes' with an arrow at the bottom-left; kiosk could be intended in the arrow's corner, but the grey marked hex is col0 row3
notes: Grid shape matches Map 0. Side panels identical to Map 0. Only left-edge difference: first yellow (once) token is reputation 2 (mortarboard '2') instead of worker 1. Underlying terrain of start hexes is plain with no bonus.
